propositions: ADR 0101 must be created as an amendment to ADR 0043 recording the rename of `operator` and retained alias, explaining the semantic confusion between human agent and Gerrit vote attester.
The term `operator` mis-signalled intent because it implied a human actor when agents recording votes attest equally well; this rationale must be documented.
`[non-codebase]` token was missing as the complement to the existing `[codebase]` prompt-level token, and its addition prevents attestation laundering by requiring authors to assert false claims.
`attested` alone was rejected because SOURCE_ATTESTED gate uses that exact term with near-opposite meaning (immutable in-repo SHA pinning), creating reader confusion.
`[operator-attested]` remains accepted but deliberately undocumented because 827 of 4,285 live tickets carry it in immutable event records.
ADR 0043 remains unmodified as historical record; scripts/gen_adr_index.py, scripts/check_adr_numbers.py, and scripts/check_docs_index.py must pass validation.
